title: Spacious 4BR Bachelor Retreat-Game Room & Rooftop!
description:
Unwind and Explore: Your Nashville Getaway. Experience the best of Music City in this stylish four-bedroom apartment, located just eight minutes from downtown Nashville. Whether you’re here for the vibrant nightlife, legendary Honky Tonks, or a relaxing retreat, this modern and comfortable space has everything you need for an unforgettable stay.

The space
★ LIVING ROOM ★
Gather with friends and family in the inviting living room, designed for relaxation and entertainment.
✔ Comfortable Sofas with Pillows 
✔ Flat-Screen TV 
✔ Coffee Table 
✔ Sofa

★ KITCHEN ★ 
The kitchen area with numerous cooking appliances and spacious countertops is at the top of the stairs. If you want to take a break from the restaurants, then this is the place for you. 
✔ Microwave
✔ Stove
✔ Oven 
✔ Refrigerator/Freezer 
✔ Dishwasher 
✔ Toaster 
✔ Blender
✔ Sink - Hot & Cold Water 
✔ Trays 
✔ Glasses 
✔ Silverware 
✔ Pots & Pans
★GAMEROOM★
While Broadway’s bars are only minutes away, you don’t even need to leave the house to have a good time. This home features its very own Bar & Game Room—the ultimate hangout spot.
Crack open a cold beer or pour some Tennessee whiskey, then kick back with:
✔ Two big-screen TVs for all the sports action
✔ A full-size pool table
✔ Dartboard for friendly competitions
It’s game night, Nashville style.
★ ROOFTOP★
Looking for the perfect party spot? Head upstairs to your private rooftop bar. Whether it’s cocktails at sunset or late-night laughs under the stars, this is the ultimate hang-out for family and friends.
Your very own rooftop oasis—cheers to that!
★ 4 BEDROOMS ★
The bedrooms feature a comfortable bed designed to provide you with the perfect resting experience. 
Bedroom 1:
✔ (2) Full–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (1 Bunkbed - sleeps 4)
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 
Bedroom 2:
✔ Queen–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (Sleeps 2)
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 
Bedroom 3:
✔ (2) Full–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (2 Bunkbeds - sleeps 4)
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 
Bedroom 4:
✔ King–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (Sleeps 2)
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 
2nd Floor Hallway:
✔ (2) Twin–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (1 Bunkbed - Sleeps 2)

★ 4 BATHROOMS ★ 
The apartment features spacious full bathrooms stocked with all necessities and essential toiletries, so you don’t need to bring your own. 
✔ Mirrors 
✔ Toilet 
✔ Towels 
✔ Essential Toiletries

Guest access
The apartment is exclusively yours, without interruption for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home. 

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home is also equipped with: 
✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi 
✔ Air Conditioning 
✔ Heating 
✔ Ceiling Fan 
✔ Washer/Dryer (in the unit)
